messages:
Alex W: Quick Q3 OKR micro-check — two minutes please. What's shipped, what's slipped, owners, and any dependency asks? I'll capture.
Priya S: Shipped: telemetry dashboard beta rolled to 10% of org, backend + UI. Docs updated in /docs/telemetry. :shipit:
Marc L: Slip: runtime-v2 canary delayed — blocked on kernel tuning results on P4 pool. Related infra ticket INF-321. ETA ~+2w unless kernel tweak helps.
Emily R: Code review pings: PRs needing attention: #4821 (telemetry ui fixes), #4867 (batching knobs). 4821 needs product acceptance on the widget behaviour. @Alex W can you quick-approve after you sanity-check?
Alex W: on it, reviewing now. Please add the acceptance checklist inline so it's clear.
Danielle K: Ownership note: I'll own the telemetry rollout checklist and post status to the OKR board. Need an SRE owner for the canary runbook. @Jordan (PM) any constraints from product on canary acceptance?
Jordan (PM): Product acceptance: target 95% P99 parity with current prod and <5% quality regression on the eval set. For canary, we can provisionally accept 90% P99 if runbook + rollback plan are explicit. :thinking_face:
Marc L: Eng-infra suggested trying this kernel flag and a lighter batching profile first:
```
export RUNTIME_KERNEL=fastpath_v2
TF_BATCHING_PROFILE=light
```
I'll run perf tests today and post results here.
ops-bot: deploy canary-2026-03-16 initiated by Marc L — logs: https://deploys.company/canary-2026-03-16 (tailing).
Priya S: Next steps I see: (1) Product vets dashboards (Jordan) (2) SRE runbook owner volunteers (3) Marc posts perf numbers + decision (4) Alex finishes CR for #4821. I'll update the OKR card with shipped/slipped and owners.
Emily R: Two small UX follow-ups found in beta; I'll open a follow-up PR after #4821 merges. Keeping those low risk.
Jordan (PM): If perf is within the canary acceptance window we greenlight staged rollout. If not, revert and iterate on kernel/batching.
Alex W: TL;DR: shipped = telemetry beta (owner Priya), slipped = runtime-v2 canary (owner Marc, +2w currently), action items: Alex review #4821, Marc post perf, SRE runbook owner needed, Jordan confirm acceptance thresholds. I'll ping owners tomorrow in this thread. :calendar:
Danielle K: I can draft the canary runbook this week and loop in SRE for validation. Will post a checklist by EOW.
SRE Sam: happy to validate the runbook once drafted — ping me and I'll slot time. :+1:
Alex W: thanks everyone — captured. Closing async check. :white_check_mark:
